# GitHub Repository About

Use these values in the repository's GitHub **About** panel (the gear icon on the main repository page).

> Repository description, website, and topics are **repository-level settings**. Merging this document does not automatically update the GitHub About panel.

## Description

A security-focused authentication service built with Java 17 and Spring Boot 4, featuring JWT authentication, refresh token rotation, revocable sessions, Redis rate limiting, email verification, audit logging, and integration tests.

## Website

https://github.com/rahimhashemi/secure-auth-service
